messages:
nina_sales: Heads up team — Prospect (HelioSystems) wants to kickoff a paid POC but surfaced three blockers: (1) must have a signed orderform before any billing; (2) DPA has an old subprocessor clause that allows transfers w/o notice; (3) EU entity says final MSA must be wet-ink. Also they asked about customer-managed keys (HSM). Tagging @rachel_legal @marc_procure @arun_se @tom_security @finance_ops.

rachel_legal: Can you paste the exact DPA language they provided? If its the permissive-transfer wording we typically replace it with notice + objection window or a named-subprocessor appendix.

nina_sales: Their snippet: ```"Vendor may engage legacy subprocessors and transfer data internationally without prior notice except where prohibited."```

rachel_legal: That's too broad. Two options: (A) Replace with "Vendor will maintain a list of subprocessors, notify Customer of changes, and Customer has 30 days to object; transfers use SCCs/equivalent safeguards." (B) Provide a named-subprocessor appendix and require written consent for additions. I can drop both redlines. Option A is our default.

marc_procure: On the PO/orderform requirement: we can delay activation until we have a signed orderform/PO. Alternatively we accept pre-billed credits (customer pays up front) and activate immediately. Finance prefers pre-bill for enterprise pilots. @finance_ops can confirm Net terms.

finance_ops: Net30 standard; Net45 requires commercial signoff. Pre-bill invoices can be Net0 (payable on receipt) to unblock POCs. Also recommend adding an overage cap on the orderform (e.g., $1k-$2k) to avoid disputes.

arun_se: Technical: Hosted public API cannot bind to customer HSM. Dedicated or Private deployments support customer-managed keys/HSM. If they insist on HSM for the POC we need to scope as Dedicated and provision hardware; lead time ~7-12 business days and cost uplift ~25%+. Short-term workaround: client-side encryption or using our managed KMS with strict key separation, but procurement often rejects that.

tom_security: We need them to complete our security questionnaire and provide SOC2 report. Ask their EU legal team to cite the regulation/policy that mandates wet-ink; many EU subs accept eSign with audit trail. If they still insist, we can accept wet-ink for final MSA but propose eSign for the POC orderform only.

nina_sales: Two asks: Rachel  please post the two DPA redline options in this thread so I can forward to their counsel. Arun  confirm lead time + exact cost delta if Dedicated + HSM required. Marc/Finance  confirm whether pre-bill is acceptable and suggested overage cap. Tom  I'll ask the customer for the legal text that mandates wet-ink.

rachel_legal: Will post both redlines by COB. Draft protective language for eSign-first approach: "Orderform executed electronically permits POC activation only; final MSA execution (electronic or wet-ink) governs production usage. Liability and data processing terms during POC limited as set forth herein."

arun_se: Confirmed: Dedicated provisioning 7-12 business days; HSM binding requires configuration during setup. Cost: ballpark +25% on POC pricing for Dedicated; if we use a minimal pilot instance we can reduce uplift to ~10-15% and fast-track to ~5 business days. Need to know desired concurrency.

marc_procure: Pre-bill is ok. Recommend $1,500 overage cap for the POC unless customer requests higher. If they insist no billing w/o signed orderform then we need PO before activation.

docusign-bot: Created envelope ENV-9001 for HelioSystems POC orderform (expires in 12 days). Signers: HelioSystems PO contact, nina_sales. Status: pending.

finance_ops: Note: if we accept eSign now and they later require wet-ink MSA, mark revenue as "POC-eSign limited" in accounting metadata to prevent premature recognition of production revenue.

nina_sales: I'll propose this flow to the customer: 1) eSign orderform with pre-billed credits + $1.5k overage cap to start POC immediately; 2) request their legal cite for wet-ink requirement and offer wet-ink MSA for final contract only; 3) if HSM is non-negotiable, pause hosted POC and move to Dedicated with revised orderform (lead time/cost noted). Sending Omar's (Rachel's) redlines + security questionnaire link now. Will update thread after their reply. :pray:

rachel_legal: FYI I'll include fallback language to allow eSign POC activation with explicit carveouts for production. Saves timeline.

arun_se: Also note: if they want EU-only residency + HSM we must provision Dedicated in EU region; add that to the orderform residency clause.

nina_sales: Good catch. I'll confirm EU residency requirement in the ask. Leaving thread open until customer responds.
